name: Linden Seating Co.
description: Seating specialist. Discount warehouse: some of the lowest prices in town, plain finishes, no frills. We carry armchairs, office chairs, dining chairs, stools.
skill_description: We sell armchairs, office chairs, dining chairs, stools, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
